read_inputs: direct pinned WEB Philippians USFM text and coordinates
neutral WEB reader and exact-coordinate coverage logic

decision_policy.primary_rule: Prefer the largest unit completing one thanksgiving, report, deliberation, appeal, poetic example, exhortation, coworker report, polemic, paraenesis, gift account, or closing operation without absorbing the next.

macro_parents.function: Prescript, thanksgiving and partnership report, and discernment prayer.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Thanksgiving grounds and prayer petitions remain one opening movement.

macro_parents.function: Imprisonment/gospel-advance and rival-preaching report followed by life-death deliberation and confidence.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Phil.1.18/1.19 may join rejoicing to the report or launch deliberation; both routes remain held.

macro_parents.function: Worthy-conduct and unity appeal, poetic/confessional example, and obedience-shining-labor application.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Cross-chapter conduct-unity continuity and the 2.5-11 example/application sequence govern the parent.

macro_parents.function: Timothy and Epaphroditus coworker reports, plans, rationales, and commendations.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The two reports are distinct examples within one coworker-travel parent.

macro_parents.function: Rejoicing warning, confidence catalogue, loss/gain and knowing movement, pressing appeal, imitation/citizenship contrast, and stand-firm inference.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Phil.4.1 is the therefore application of Phil.3.17-21 despite the chapter seam.

macro_parents.function: Named dispute and coworker remedy followed by rejoicing, gentleness, prayer, thought, and practice paraenesis.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Phil.4.3/4.4 distinguishes local reconciliation from the wider exhortation while preserving the parent.

macro_parents.function: Renewed-gift gratitude, qualification, contentment and partnership account, doxology, greetings, and grace close.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Gift thanks, accounting qualification, blessing, greetings, and grace remain the larger epistolary close.

units.literary_rationale: The joint sender, addressee, and greeting form a compact prescript before first-person thanksgiving.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating sender and greeting obscures the prescript.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: Addressee and office terms do not authorize authorship, audience, or office rulings.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Thanksgiving, partnership confidence, longing, and discernment prayer
units.literary_rationale: Thanksgiving and partnership grounds lead through confidence and longing into a discernment prayer with its stated horizon.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting thanks from prayer removes the relational grounds of the petitions.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No partnership, salvation, righteousness, or discernment doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Imprisonment advance, rival motives, and rejoicing outcome
units.literary_rationale: The imprisonment report develops through public and communal effects, rival motives, and the conclusion that proclamation produces rejoicing.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating rival motives from rejoicing loses the report outcome.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: The future-rejoicing phrase at 1.18 is a Janus seam before 1.19 reasoning.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No imprisonment location, rival identity, motive history, or proclamation doctrine is selected.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Life-death deliberation and confident communal horizon
units.literary_rationale: The life-death antithesis becomes an explicit deliberation, weighs two alternatives, and resolves provisionally toward communal progress.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Extracting 1.21-24 creates a slogan and removes deliberative resolution.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Phil.1.27 switches to an only-conduct imperative.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No martyrdom, afterlife, salvation, chronology, or prediction doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Worthy conduct, shared conflict, and unity appeal
units.literary_rationale: The worthy-conduct appeal moves through shared conflict into a fourfold conditional unity appeal and concrete other-regard.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: A chapter split severs shared conflict from therefore-unity.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Phil.2.5 introduces the example with a new mind imperative.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No citizenship, suffering, unity, humility, or ethics doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Mind appeal and self-emptying/exaltation poetic example
units.literary_rationale: The framing mind appeal introduces a complete descent-exaltation movement whose parallel climax supplies the exemplum.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting poetic predicates or detaching the frame turns the movement into a source fragment.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No hymn source, quotation extent, Christology, worship, or cosmology ruling is made.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Obedience, shining, labor, drink-offering, and mutual rejoicing
units.literary_rationale: The so-then application binds obedience to divine-work rationale, shining/labor imagery, and the drink-offering exemplum with reciprocal rejoicing.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching shining or offering imagery removes command rationale and outcome.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Phil.2.19 begins a named travel plan.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No salvation, obedience, sacrifice, ethics, or perfection doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The intended sending, desired outcome, character comparison, proven service, timing contingency, and personal travel hope form one report.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating character rationale from travel plan weakens the commendation.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Phil.2.25 switches to Epaphroditus and an already necessary sending.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No office, itinerary, chronology, or character authority is established.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Epaphroditus report, sending rationale, and commendation
units.literary_rationale: The report moves from relational identification and distress through illness and sending purposes to commands of reception and honor.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching commendation from report removes its rationale.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No office, illness history, risk, honor practice, event sequence, or chronology is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Rejoicing warning, credentials catalogue, loss-gain, and knowing aim
units.literary_rationale: The rejoicing/safety transition introduces warning, counter-definition, credentials, and their revaluation through the knowing and attainment aim.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Atomizing credentials or loss/gain terms removes the polemical revaluation.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Phil.3.12 begins an explicit not-already correction and pressing metaphor.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No opponent, circumcision, law, righteousness, salvation, resurrection, or perfection doctrine is selected.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Not-yet pressing, mature-minded appeal, imitation, citizenship contrast, and stand firm
units.literary_rationale: The not-yet correction and pressing image yield a mature-minded appeal, exempla contrast, citizenship horizon, and therefore stand-firm conclusion across the chapter seam.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting 4.1 removes the explicit inference from the citizenship contrast.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Phil.4.2 begins a named reconciliation appeal.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No perfection, imitation, enemy, citizenship, body, or eschatology doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The parallel exhortations name the dispute, and the partner appeal supplies a concrete remedy grounded in shared labor.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating named appeals from the helper request removes the proposed remedy.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: Phil.4.4 broadens to general rejoicing and paraenesis.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No dispute history, gender, office, mediation policy, or book-of-life doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Rejoicing, gentleness, prayer, thought, and practice
units.literary_rationale: The command cluster links rejoicing and gentleness to prayer, peace, disciplined attention, received example, practice, and a second peace promise.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Atomizing prayer or virtue items turns the paraenetic sequence into slogans.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No anxiety, prayer, virtue, ethics, mental-health, or peace doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Renewed gift, contentment qualification, partnership account, supply, and doxology
units.literary_rationale: Gratitude is carefully qualified by contentment, then reframed as shared affliction and accounting fruit before receipt, supply, and doxology.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Extracting contentment, ability, gift, or supply statements creates financial or devotional slogans.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No benefaction history, financial policy, contentment, ability, supply, or reward doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.literary_rationale: The outgoing command, incoming greetings, marked household note, and grace formula perform the final epistolary close.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching the benediction fragments the reciprocal close.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: No following received Philippians coordinate exists.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No Caesar-household history, audience, canon, or grace doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve all exact routes, and defer to human or external-AI review.

global_premortems.detection: Thanks, partnership grounds, or petitions become separate slogans.
Imprisonment or rival motives are detached from gospel-advance and rejoicing outcomes.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain Phil.1.12-18 and its larger parent.

global_premortems.detection: Life/death alternatives are detached from reasoning and resolution.
Phil.1.30/2.1 or 3.21/4.1 is split solely by chapter.
Phil.2.5-11 boundaries are used to assert a hymn source, quotation, or Christology.
global_premortems.mitigation: Preserve frame and exact alternatives; authorize nothing.

global_premortems.detection: Obedience, shining, labor, or offering imagery is atomized.
Travel reports become office, chronology, or historical reconstructions.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep each person, rationale, plan, and commendation together.

global_premortems.detection: Credentials or loss/gain terms become independent proof texts.
Pressing, maturity, imitation, citizenship, and stand-firm inference are separated.
Named appeal is converted into gender, office, or mediation policy.
Prayer or virtue-list items become context-free commands.
Gift, contentment, ability, accounting, or supply claims become financial rules.
A seam selects witness, reading, punctuation, hymn source, speaker, opponent, or imprisonment setting.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep every seam LOW/deferred with exact alternatives.
